sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Use actual recording tools and observable route evidence to map while moving at the adopted normal travel pace. This expressly permits that narrow concurrent mapping; it does not permit another incompatible Watch job. NEW: track ten accumulated active minutes on one identified continuous route or area, pausing when unable to observe or record. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When you actually cause a living dying creature to become Stable by a legal Medicine stabilization or a real healer's-kit use, offer that recipient 1 HP. If positive HP is gained, clear the obsolete Stable deadline normally. A separately owned Field Medic temp-HP offer still uses the genuine stabilization event, even if the recipient is now at 1 HP. Already Stable or dead creatures create no new trigger.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The current source names two bonus effects without defining either. NEW complete proposal for discussion: once per completed long rest, after you personally finish a legal successful forage task yielding actual edible material, designate at most your current PB ordinary portions from that finite yield. Spend 30 active minutes with an actual cooking kit, safe heat and water if the food needs them to prepare those portions. No extra food, ingredients or Supply are created; record the original forage batch and its real quantities. Each designated portion has exactly two proposed riders: (1) Trail-ready preparation pauses its ordinary unprotected spoilage clock for the next six elapsed hours while kept clean in an appropriate container, after which its prior age resumes; breach or contamination ends this protection and other preservation does not add the intervals. (2) The eater may add +1 to one actual Constitution save against ordinary foodborne illness or food poisoning within one elapsed hour after fully consuming the portion, declaring before that roll. This does not work against magical poison, weapon poison, existing illness or non-food hazards. Record one recipient entitlement per completed long rest across all Wilderness Chefs; consuming another portion neither refreshes nor stacks it. Pay the cook's use at preparation start, even if interrupted. A poisoned or unsafe ingredient is not made edible; no other cooked recipe, Chef-serving or Feast effect is added to the same physical portion. These two riders are deliberately proposed new text, not recovered source or an interpretation of the legacy +10%.
